method: Independent source review plus execution of actual C# production store and quantity adapters with explicit CAD doubles and actual synthetic zone-engine fixtures.

findings.reproduction: Existing non-DBDictionary extension object was treated as absent zone parameters.
findings.resolution: ReadZone now refuses the malformed existing dictionary; regression verifies it cannot become inheritance.

findings.reproduction: ClearZone accepted a missing verified fingerprint.
findings.resolution: WriteZone and ClearZone both require an explicit nonempty verified fingerprint before any write; regression verifies refusal.

policy_checks: Ordinary consumers reject changed generation; the explicit editor may rebind the same owner only with fresh caller verification, old raw CAS and valid self-pointer.
COPY owner/self-pointer corruption remains a refusal, including during explicit generation rebind.
Absent, malformed, explicit null, explicit empty array and removed binding remain distinct.
Raw JSON digest is separate from semantic content digest; raw-only changes invalidate CAS and dependent quantities.
Legacy source hashes match the baseline when no zone binding exists; unbound legacy results ignore later project changes.
Read contexts cache project and zone snapshots within one phase; a new context sees changed data, while writers always perform fresh CAS.

performance.timing_scope: Diagnostic Mono and managed CAD-double timings; no AutoCAD performance claim.
performance.cad_access_conclusion: 100/1000 consumers share one project or same-owner zone Xrecord read; distinct zones use N Xrecord reads and 2N GetObject calls. Quantity reading retains exactly one existing shared ModelSpace scan; no additional scan is introduced.

limits: Rollback is verified only by an explicit in-memory transaction model, not AutoCAD Undo or database runtime.
No AutoCAD COPY reference remapping, save/reopen, document locking, WinForms or Windows frozen-engine runtime acceptance is claimed.
This receipt covers persistence and quantity freshness. Actual command orchestration has a separate review.
Concurrent live geometry mutation between ATFRAME UI/calculation/write phases is outside this probe and requires host validation.
